37 DAYS, ALL EXPENSES INCLUDED, $275.00
Same trip leaving New York, July 15th, arriving London, July 25th, continue as in above itinerary from London to New York, all expenses included, $175.00
This rate includes steamer passage, going and returning, railroad fares throughout, good hotels, carriage drives and side trips as stated in itinerary, free allowance of 60 pounds of baggage in addition to usual hand baggage, ordinary gratuities to hotel servants, porters and guards, and the services of an experienced manager from port of arrival in Europe to departure for America.
